BiblicalUsage: Paraq is broth, soup full of crumbled meat. It appears once, in Isaiah 65:4, among the practices of the rebellious people God denounces: they sit among the graves, lodge in the monuments, eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the broth in the pot tells the story of a people who had stopped caring what God called abominable.
